mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.4% signals sustained monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital and enhanced risk appetite.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.4% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative equity returns over 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 780) and retail sales (RSAFS < 350000) signal weakening consumer demand, generating negative equity returns over 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when HOUST < 780 and RSAFS < 350000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 215 indicates persistent inflation, triggering monetary tightening cycles that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 11700 (GDPC1 > 11700) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting positive equity returns over 5 trading days through elevated corporate earnings momentum and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when GDPC1 > 11700 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105 (INDPRO < 105) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profit growth expectations, generating negative equity returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 105 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate > 6.5% and employment decline (PAYEMS < 136000) indicates severe labor market stress, triggering recession fears and negative equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5% and PAYEMS < 136000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 780 (HOUST > 780) signals renewed consumer confidence and spending, generating positive equity returns over 5 trading days through increased retail and construction sector activity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST > 780 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
